title: Effects of Interpersonal Psychotherapy on Depression During and After Pregnancy
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the impact of interpersonal psychotherapy on the course of depression during and after pregnancy, as well as its effect on infant birth outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* No more than 28 weeks pregnant at the time of study entry
* History of depression or anxiety
* Current symptoms of distress
* Score of 9 or greater on the Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS)
* English-speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Plans to move away from the area prior to giving birth
* Current use of steroids for medical conditions
